stops.name: Watzmann
stops.quote: Or perhaps she was also delighted by the venison he brought back from his forays in the shadow of the Watzmann and Kehlstein mountains, which offered a change from the never-ending grain groats that otherwise dominated meal times at Sulzbach Castle.
stops.english: Or perhaps she was also delighted by the venison he brought back from his forays in the shadow of the Watzmann and Kehlstein mountains, which offered a change from the never-ending grain groats that otherwise dominated meal times at Sulzbach Castle.

stops.name: Kehlstein
stops.quote: Today, the brine pipeline path leads along the former route with a view over the roofs of Berchtesgaden as well as to Jenner, Watzmann and the Kehlstein.
stops.english: Today, the brine pipeline path leads along the former route with a view over the roofs of Berchtesgaden as well as to Jenner, Watzmann and the Kehlstein.

stops.name: collegiate church of Berchtesgaden
stops.quote: It was exactly where he had suffered the hunting accident that the collegiate church of Berchtesgaden was later erected, built by son Berengar, who redeemed his mother’s vow.
stops.english: It was exactly where he had suffered the hunting accident that the collegiate church of Berchtesgaden was later erected, built by son Berengar, who redeemed his mother’s vow.

stops.name: Royal Castle
stops.quote: This stands just a few metres from the market square with its façade-painted houses.
stops.english: This stands just a few metres from the market square with its façade-painted houses.

stops.name: Haus der Berge
stops.quote: Where today visitors to the “Watzmann Therme” springs can enjoy a splash in the warm brine water or experience the vertical wilderness of the national park in the “Haus der Berge”, the monks found “treacherous forest and snow-starved wasteland”, where they even suspected a breeding ground for dragons, as can be read in their writings.
stops.english: Where today visitors to the “Watzmann Therme” springs can enjoy a splash in the warm brine water or experience the vertical wilderness of the national park in the “Haus der Berge”, the monks found “treacherous forest and snow-starved wasteland”, where they even suspected a breeding ground for dragons, as can be read in their writings.

stops.name: Priesbergalm
stops.quote: “After a small glass of gentian, you can handle any dragon,” says mountain distiller Max Irlinger on the Priesbergalm.
stops.english: “After a small glass of gentian, you can handle any dragon,” says mountain distiller Max Irlinger on the Priesbergalm.

stops.name: Jenner
stops.quote: It would be hard to drink gentian more authentically than on a wooden bench situated in front of the hut in the Jenner region above Berchtesgaden.
stops.english: It would be hard to drink gentian more authentically than on a wooden bench situated in front of the hut in the Jenner region above Berchtesgaden.

stops.name: Obersalzberg Documentation Center
stops.quote: The history of the site during the Nazi era is retraced in a permanent exhibition at the Obersalzberg Documentation Center
stops.english: The history of the site during the Nazi era is retraced in a permanent exhibition at the Obersalzberg Documentation Center

stops.name: Lake Königsee
stops.quote: The mountain world of the National Park and UNESCO Biosphere Reserve is interactively presented on several floors, from the depths of Lake Königsee up to its tree-free peaks.
stops.english: The mountain world of the National Park and UNESCO Biosphere Reserve is interactively presented on several floors, from the depths of Lake Königsee up to its tree-free peaks.
